mechanism_narrative: The steady week-to-week decline in WORKPLACES and TRANSIT reflects a continuing shift away from commuting and central-city trips. candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL above 15 points while WORKPLACES stays below -10 points
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases over the next 14 days despite RESIDENTIAL staying above 15 and WORKPLACES staying below -10 throughout the period.
